created_products.why_interesting: Newly published Nature Aging research directly links dysregulated iron metabolism in aging neurons to memory loss, creating a credible hook for a brain-health supplement targeting iron balance.

Rhamnolipid biosurfactants are microbially-derived compounds with proven ability to break down the lipid-rich sebum and apocrine secretions that bind BO-causing bacteria to fabric fibers — a mechanism standard enzymes and detergents miss, making it a compelling premium solution for the persistent armpit odor problem this post describes.
